therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: CD52-targeted monoclonal antibody-mediated lymphocyte depletion combined with cytotoxic chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: elimination of leukemic lymphoblasts through targeted immunotherapy and cytotoxic mechanisms
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with relapsed or refractory acute lymphoblastic leukemia

safety_signals: severe cytopenias (leukocytes decreased in 100% of patients)
results.dose_information: alemtuzumab given subcutaneously, combined with MOAD chemotherapy regimen including methotrexate, vincristine, asparaginase, dexamethasone

context.duration: treatment duration not specified, median overall survival 5.2 months
